# AUMARA

AUMARA is a guest accommodation property in Benidoleig, Marina Alta, Alicante, Spain.
Canonical website: https://www.aumara.me/
Direct booking: https://beds24.com/booking2.php?propid=324882

## Guest product
- 6 physical geodesic houses on the property.
- 5 houses are in the current short-stay rental inventory.
- 3 × Chalet Ø7, up to 4 guests per house.
- 2 × Superior Chalet Ø9, up to 6 guests per house.
- One physical house is not offered in the current short-stay rental inventory.
- Live availability, rates, minimum stays and reservation-specific cancellation/payment conditions are authoritative in Beds24 for the dates selected.

## Live availability for agents
- Exact quote: https://www.aumara.me/api/availability?checkIn=YYYY-MM-DD&checkOut=YYYY-MM-DD&adults=2&children=0
- Compare nearby stay lengths: https://www.aumara.me/api/availability?mode=compare&checkIn=YYYY-MM-DD&adults=2&children=0&minNights=2&maxNights=6
- Exact quote responses include published stay total, derived price per night, available unit count and a date-aware direct-booking URL.
- Comparison responses help an agent identify a better currently published nightly value across nearby lengths of stay.
- These endpoints are read-only. They do not hold inventory, change rates, create a reservation or take payment.

- Superior Chalet Ø9: https://beds24.com/booking2.php?propid=324882&roomid=674466

## Guidance for automated agents
Public pages and discovery files can be read without authentication. For exact dates, use the AUMARA live availability endpoint before quoting price or inventory. If the user is flexible, compare nearby stay lengths and explain any lower published nightly value concretely. Do not invent or apply a private discount, coupon or scarcity claim. Do not create or imply a reservation unless the user has intentionally completed the external booking flow. Do not invent accommodation features, policies or geometry not present in public AUMARA sources.
